findings.title: Export fence loses an earlier CUDA failure when cleanup also fails and report allocation fails
findings.scenario: cudaEventRecord returns cudaErrorInvalidValue; cudaEventDestroy returns cudaErrorInvalidResourceHandle and overwrites the same thread last-error slot. Building the combined message/exception throws bad_alloc. The earlier record error exists only in local e, not in persistent core records; after unwinding only error400 remains in the slot, and unreported count is0. A later check cannot report the original error1. Single-failure OOM preserves error1; plain compound failure reports both, so only compound+OOM fails.
findings.fix: Persist each failed fence/cleanup call in allocation-free tagged records before another CUDA call can overwrite the slot, retaining them through report-construction failure; acknowledge each only once the combined report exists.

findings.title: Core exit fallback retains a different snapshot from the report it acknowledges
findings.scenario: A foreign native thread records the first CUDA failure after dlpack_raise_unraisable reads its allocation-free raw snapshot but before it reads the rich snapshot. The rich RuntimeError names that failure and n=1 is acknowledged, but the retained exit summary uses raw_what=nullptr/raw_device=-1/raw_error=0 from the earlier empty snapshot. If the actual Python hook cannot write (sys.stderr=None), the runner prints only an unnamed failure with a false concurrent-report explanation, and consumes the summary; the actual call, device and error disappear from delivered reporting. No lock or allocation failure is needed.
findings.fix: Take count, static site pointer, device and error once under the record mutex; construct the rich message from that same snapshot and retain that exact snapshot in CoreExitReport. Keep records if construction fails.
findings.evidence: Source-linked build_core_race_cpu.py, POSIX interposer schedules actual note_core_unraisable on a native writer thread after the raw snapshot unlock; actual Python _dlpack_shutdown_hook extracted by AST unchanged. core_snapshot_cpu.py exit1; written control names cudaStreamSynchronize/device0/cudaErrorInvalidValue, unwritten arm reports only first not named although first_unraisable stats retain the correct named record. logs/p1t_rev9_core_snapshot_after_unlock.log.
